message.content: Based on the discussion, Helios suggests several games that offer tactical gameplay along with compelling stories and character development. He recommends "XCOM 2" for its tactical gameplay, noting that it requires strategic thinking and offers many customization options for the squad. Additionally, Helios mentions "Fire Emblem" as another game that he enjoys due to its blend of RPG elements and character development. Both "XCOM 2" and "Fire Emblem" are games that fit the criteria of offering strategic depth and rich character narratives.
